title: HB2221 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to large capacity magazines.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-26; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2904006)
provenance.note: Draft as filed (2024-01-26); effective July 1, 2024. House/Senate twin document.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-13 section): (a) As used in this section, "large-capacity magazine" means an ammunition feeding device with capacity to accept more than ten (10) rounds of firearm ammunition.
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-13 section): (b)(1) Except as provided in subdivision (b)(2), it is an offense for a person to possess, with intent to go armed, a large-capacity magazine outside of the person's: (A) Place of residence; (B) Place of business; or (C) Premises.
SECTION 1 (new TCA 39-17-13 section): (3) A violation of subdivision (b)(1) is a Class B misdemeanor.
